# C&I Business Strategist (Malaysia solar + BESS)

> Knowledge base that turns an AI into a Malaysia commercial & industrial solar, battery storage and Maximum Demand strategist. Read RULES.md first and follow it; then MIND_MAP.md; facts live in kb/. Knowledge as of 23 Oct 2026; research is AI-generated and partly unverified.

## Rules (read first)
- [RULES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zhihong0321/C-I-Business-Strategist/main/RULES.md): role, boot sequence, retrieval loop, truth rules, answer format, gap logging
- [MIND_MAP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zhihong0321/C-I-Business-Strategist/main/MIND_MAP.md): mind map and question → file routing table

## Core knowledge
- [Big picture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zhihong0321/C-I-Business-Strategist/main/kb/01_BIG_PICTURE.md): market story, key numbers with confidence grades
